data.title: Infrastructure Network Feasibility Toolkit
data.subtitle: Transforming network feasibility analysis from tribal knowledge into a repeatable decision engine.
data.description: A reusable decision-support solution that replaced manual dependency on domain experts with a structured, scalable workflow for evaluating network feasibility.

data.title: A decision engine for network feasibility.
paragraphs: Network feasibility assessments previously depended on a small group of specialists who carried the logic, assumptions, and edge cases in their heads. That made every evaluation slow, inconsistent, and difficult to scale.

We designed an Excel-first toolkit powered by Office Scripts that encodes the feasibility workflow into a reusable decision-support process — so teams can evaluate options quickly without waiting for scarce expert bandwidth.
highlights: Codified expert judgment into structured, auditable steps
Reduced evaluation cycle time from days to minutes
Delivered as an MVP that teams can extend without rewriting the core logic

data.title: Feasibility lived as tribal knowledge.
data.body: Critical network decisions were bottlenecked by specialist availability. Assumptions varied by person, documentation was thin, and repeating an analysis meant rebuilding context from scratch.
bullets: Expert-dependent reviews created multi-day turnaround times
Inconsistent criteria made outcomes hard to compare across scenarios
No durable workflow existed for non-specialists to run first-pass assessments

data.title: From informal judgment to a structured workflow.
data.intro: We translated domain expertise into a transparent decision model, then automated the repetitive layers so analysts could focus on interpretation instead of reconstruction.

steps.title: Map the decision logic
steps.body: Worked with domain experts to capture feasibility criteria, dependencies, and exception paths in a form that could be reviewed and tested.

steps.title: Build the Excel decision surface
steps.body: Designed a familiar spreadsheet interface for inputs, scenario comparison, and clear output states — without forcing users into a new platform.

steps.title: Automate with Office Scripts
steps.body: Encoded repeatable calculations and validation checks so the same evaluation path could run consistently in minutes.

steps.title: Validate with synthetic recreation
steps.body: Recreated representative scenarios to prove the toolkit matched expert outcomes before rolling it into day-to-day use.

data.title: Need a decision system your team can actually run?
data.body: We help organizations turn expert-dependent processes into structured analytics and automation — starting with practical MVPs that create immediate operating leverage.
